---
title: Import and export
sidebar_position: 3
---

:::info Required, format still open
Importing and exporting TARA projects is part of the required scope. File formats,
schema versions, validation rules, and merge behaviour have not yet been agreed.
:::

The completed guide will document supported formats, how to export a project,
how to import it, and how errors are reported. It will also explain which data
and metadata are included and how permissions are treated during a transfer.

Example files will be published only after the format is implemented and tested.
